subject: India’s oil bill: a plate of dollars, a bite 60 per cent bigger
alt: Subhani’s cartoon: in the middle a stout man in black sits cross-legged, a white disc behind his head reading ‘INDIA’S OIL BILL’. In front of him is a big dish brimming with dollar notes. In one hand he holds an ornate golden fork with a note speared on it, and his mouth is stuffed with notes; in the other hand he holds an oil barrel. In a box at the upper right it says: ‘FUEL IMPORT BILL RISES 60%’. The cartoonist’s signature is at the lower right.
chutki: ‘India’s oil bill’, sitting cross-legged, eats dollar notes with a golden fork, an oil barrel in one hand and a dish heaped with dollars before him. The box above says the fuel import bill has risen by sixty per cent.
The needle: the appetite for oil is paid for in dollars every day, and the dish never empties. The cartoon draws the bill as a glutton: the bigger it gets, the more it eats.
